mostWorthwhile.text: Adding ATP was most worthwhile because the final picture connected the energy supply to two different cell jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the prepared protein builder and pump felt straightforward and a little repetitive.

surprise.text: I learned that the cell continually uses and remakes ATP, rather than simply making it once.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though some fittings mainly followed named goals and the compatibility menu rather than a choice I could independently figure out.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how working cells connect to larger body structures, though I hope there are more meaningful choices than simple fittings.
